an10.29:1.1: [sāvatthi] yāvatā bhikkhave kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijite, rājā tattha pasenadī kosalo rājā aggamakkhāyati.
an10.29:1.2: raññopi kho bhikkhave pasenadissa kosalassa attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo.
an10.29:1.3: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:1.4: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:2.1: yāvatā bhikkhave candimasuriyā pariharanti, disā bhanti virocanā, tāva sahassadhā loko.
an10.29:2.2: tasmiṃ sahassadhā loke sahassaṃ candānaṃ, sahassaṃ suriyānaṃ, sahassaṃ sinerupabbatarājānaṃ, sahassaṃ jambudīpānaṃ, sahassaṃ aparagoyānānaṃ sahassaṃ uttarakurūnaṃ, sahassaṃ pubbavidehānaṃ, cattāri mahāsamuddasahassāni, cattāri mahārājasahassāni, sahassaṃ cātummahārājikānaṃ, sahassaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ, sahassaṃ yāmānaṃ, sahassaṃ tusitānaṃ, sahassaṃ nimmāṇaratīnaṃ, sahassaṃ paranimmitavasavattīnaṃ, sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ,
an10.29:2.3: yāvatā bhikkhave sahassīlokadhātu, mahābrahmā tattha aggamakkhāyati.
an10.29:2.4: mahābrahmunopi kho bhikkhave attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo
an10.29:2.5: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:2.6: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:3.1: hoti kho so bhikkhave samayo, yaṃ ayaṃ loko saṃvaṭṭati,
an10.29:3.2: saṃvaṭṭamāne bhikkhave loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassara saṃvattanikā bhavanti,
an10.29:3.3: te tattha honti manomayā, pītibhakkhā sayaṃ pabhā antalikkhecarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīghamaddhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
an10.29:3.4: saṃvaṭṭamāne bhikkhave loke ābhassarā devā aggamakkhāyanti.
an10.29:3.5: ābhassarānampi kho bhikkhave devānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ. atthi vipariṇāmo,
an10.29:3.6: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati,
an10.29:3.7: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:4.3: paṭhavikasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
an10.29:4.4: āpokasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho, tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.
an10.29:4.12: viññāṇakasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ
an10.29:5.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ dasannaṃ kasiṇāyatanānaṃ yadidaṃ viññāṇakasiṇameko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ,
an10.29:5.3: evaṃ saññīnampi bhikkhave sattānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo.
an10.29:5.4: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:5.5: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:6.3: ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇa dubbaṇṇāni.
an10.29:7.1: ajjhattaṃ rūpasaññī ekobahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇa dubbaṇṇāni,
an10.29:7.2: tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi, passāmī’ti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an10.29:8.1: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni,
an10.29:8.2: “tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi, passāmī” ti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an10.29:9.1: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati appamāṇāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni,
an10.29:9.2: ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī’ti evaṃ saññī hoti
an10.29:10.1: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīla nidassanāni nīla nibhāsāni
an10.29:10.2: seyyathāpi nāma ummā pupphaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīlanidassanaṃ nīlanibhāsaṃ, seyyathāpi vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāga vimaṭṭhaṃ nīlaṃ nīlavaṇṇaṃ nīladassanaṃ nīla nibhāsaṃ.
an10.29:10.3: evameva ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati nīlāni nīlavaṇṇāni nīlanidassanāni.
an10.29:10.4: ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi, passāmī’ti evaṃ saññī hoti,
an10.29:11.1: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati pītāni pītavaṇṇāni pītanidassanāni, pītanibhāsāni.
an10.29:11.2: seyyathāpi nāma kaṇikārapupphaṃ pītaṃ pītavaṇṇaṃ pītanidassanaṃ pītanibhāsaṃ. seyyathāpi vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ pītaṃ pītavaṇṇaṃ pītanidassanaṃ pītanibhāsaṃ.
an10.29:11.3: evamevaṃ ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati pītāni pītavaṇṇāni pītanidassanāni pītanibhāsāni.
an10.29:11.4: ‘tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi, passāmī’ti evaṃ saññī hoti
an10.29:12.1: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati lohitakāni lohitakavaṇṇāni lohitakanidassanāni lohitakanibhāsāni
an10.29:12.2: seyyathāpi nāma bandhujīvakapupphaṃ lohitakaṃ lohitakavaṇṇaṃ lohitakanidassanaṃ lohitakanibhāsaṃ, seyyathāpi vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ lohitakaṃ lohitavaṇṇaṃ lohitakanidassanaṃ lohitaka nibhāsaṃ.
an10.29:12.3: evamevaṃ ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati lohitakāni lohitakavaṇṇāni lohitaka nidassanāni lohitaka nibhāsāni
an10.29:12.4: tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi, passāmī’ti evaṃ saññī hoti
an10.29:13.1: ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odāta nibhāsāni.
an10.29:13.2: seyyathāpi nāma osadhītārakā odātā odātavaṇṇā odātanidassanā odātanibhāsā. seyyathāpi vā pana taṃ vatthaṃ bārāṇaseyyakaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhaṃ odātaṃ odātavaṇṇaṃ odātanidassanaṃ odātanibhāsaṃ
an10.29:13.3: evamevaṃ ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni.
an10.29:14.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ aṭṭhannaṃ abhibhāyatanānaṃ yadidaṃ ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati odātāni odātavaṇṇāni odātanidassanāni odātanibhāsāni.
an10.29:14.2: tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmīti evaṃ saññī hoti.
an10.29:14.3: evaṃ saññinopi kho bhikkhave santi sattā.
an10.29:14.4: evaṃ saññīnampi kho bhikkhave sattānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo,
an10.29:14.5: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:14.6: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:16.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ paṭipadānaṃ yadidaṃ sukhā paṭipadā khippābhiññā.
an10.29:16.2: evaṃ paṭipannāpi kho bhikkhave santi sattā.
an10.29:16.3: evaṃ paṭipannānampi kho bhikkhave sattānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo.
an10.29:16.4: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:16.5: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:18.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave imāsaṃ catunnaṃ saññānaṃ yadidaṃ “natthi kiñcī”ti ākiñcaññāyatanameko sañjānāti.
an10.29:18.2: evaṃ saññinopi kho bhikkhave santi sattā.
an10.29:18.3: evaṃ saññīnampi kho bhikkhave sattānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo
an10.29:18.4: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā, ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:18.5: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:19.1: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave bāhirakānaṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ yadidaṃ no cassaṃ, no ca me siyā, na bhavissāmi, na me bhavissantīti.
an10.29:19.3: yā cāyaṃ bhave appaṭikūlyatā, sā cassa na bhavissati,
an10.29:19.4: yācāyaṃ bhavanirodhe pāṭikulyatā, sā cassa na bhavissatīti.
an10.29:19.5: evaṃ diṭṭhinopi kho bhikkhave santi sattā.
an10.29:19.6: evaṃ diṭṭhinampi kho bhikkhave sattānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo.
an10.29:19.7: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati.
an10.29:19.8: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati, pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:20.1: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā paramatthavisuddhiṃ paññāpenti.
an10.29:20.2: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave paramatthavisuddhiṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an10.29:20.3: te tadabhiññāya tassa sacchikiriyāya dhammaṃ desenti.
an10.29:20.4: evaṃ vādinopi kho bhikkhave santi sattā.
an10.29:20.5: evaṃ vādīnampi kho bhikkhave sattānaṃ attheva aññathattaṃ, atthi vipariṇāmo.
an10.29:20.6: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako tasmimpi nibbindati,
an10.29:20.7: tasmiṃ nibbindanto agge virajjati. pageva hīnasmiṃ.
an10.29:21.1: santi bhikkhave eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā paramadiṭṭhadhammanibbānavādā. te paramadiṭṭhadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ paññāpenti.
an10.29:21.2: etadaggaṃ bhikkhave paramadiṭṭhadhamma nibbānaṃ paññāpentānaṃ yadidaṃ channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ viditvā anupādā vimokkho.
an10.29:21.3: evaṃ vādiṃ kho maṃ bhikkhave evamakkhāyiṃ. eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā asatā tucchā musā abhūtena abbhācikkhanti: na
an10.29:21.4: samaṇo gotamo kāmānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti. na rūpānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpeti, na vedanānaṃ pariññaṃ paññāpetīti.
an10.29:21.5: kāmānaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave pariññaṃ paññāpemi, rūpānañca pariññaṃ paññāpemi, vedanānañca pariññaṃ paññāpemi diṭṭheva dhamme nicchāto nibbuto sītibhūto anupādā parinibbānaṃ paññāpemīti.
